source_caption:
🎬 40 Days and 40 Nights (2002)

40 Days and 40 Nights follows Matt Sullivan, a young man living in San Francisco who struggles to move on after a painful breakup. Determined to regain control of his life, Matt makes an unusual decision to give up all sexual activity for the 40 days of Lent. What initially seems like a simple personal challenge quickly becomes complicated when his friends turn his commitment into a public competition. Things become even more difficult when Matt meets Erica, a charming woman who captures his attention and makes him question his decision. As temptation, misunderstandings, and hilarious situations threaten his promise, Matt must learn what truly matters in relationships. Starring Josh Hartnett and Shannyn Sossamon, the film combines romantic comedy with outrageous humor while exploring love, self-control, commitment, and personal growth.

🎭 Genre: Romantic Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 5.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 36m • R

🎥 Director: Michael Lehmann

✍️ Writer: Rob Perez

source_details.synopsis: 40 Days and 40 Nights is a 2002 romantic comedy film directed by Michael Lehmann, written by Rob Perez, and starring Josh Hartnett, Shannyn Sossamon and Paulo Costanzo. The film depicts Matt Sullivan, a San Francisco web designer who has chosen to abstain from any sexual contact for the duration of Lent. Released on March 1, 2002 by Miramax Films in the United States and by Universal Pictures (through United International Pictures) in other territories, the film received mixed reviews from critics and grossed $95.1 million against a $17 million budget, becoming a commercial success.
